items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: You are familiar with the Bill Crow Jazz Anecdotes book?

ctx.x: Yeah it bothers me. In fact it bothered Shecky Greene. Shecky said to me one night, he says, “I’ve walked out on several comics that were too dirty for me.” You know? And we all — you know — knew all those words and you know when we were in totally male company or we were with other entertainers we’d tell jokes that are really obscene. But not in public. That’s a different thing. I couldn’t do that.
You are familiar with the Bill Crow Jazz Anecdotes book?
